description: Add a new column or lookup relationship to an existing table. Non-destructive schema mutation (existing rows receive null for the new field); requires administrative permissions. Specify either `fieldType` for a scalar column OR `lookupEntity` (and optional `lookupField`) for a foreign-key reference. Use `create_table` to create a new table, `get_table` to inspect existing fields, and `delete_field` to remove a field. Returns `{ field: { id, fieldName, displayName, fieldType, lookupEntity, lookupField } }`.

fieldName.description: Unique system name for the new field (required).

fieldType.description: Scalar data type (omit when creating a lookup via `lookupEntity`). One of: INTEGER, DOUBLE, BOOLEAN, STRING, DATETIME, DATE, TIME, TEXT, BIGINT

lookupEntity.description: Target entity `tableName` for a lookup/foreign-key field (optional; e.g. `interaction`).

lookupField.description: Referenced field on `lookupEntity` (optional). Defaults to the lookup entity's primary key.

name: add_field
